name: Stauz Czycz's species
description: This alien race were tall, muscular beings with orange skin, three-fingered hands, five green eyes, and a large, triangular head with snakelike tendrils in place of hair. Their homeworld was razed by the Empire. Stauz Czycz was a member of this species.
